1555353933673107456.a: Tired of tripping over the reciprocating fan in here. Measured the threads on the stand pipe and designed this. It clamps to a 2x4 or other 1.75" thick plane. The stand vibrates and crap. Below it I made a custom support structure. I like to design my own for a big gap like this. t.co

1555377987612205056.a: In summary, don't throw things away just because they break. Yeah, it's work to fix things but it is good for the brain.

1555619256238329856.a: Measure once and print twice, they say. Wait, maybe I have that backward... Metric threads are almost enjoyable to use. No guesswork. Though I was not able to accurately measure the stud on the fan here. M22x4 but the actual diameter is 20mm on the fan. Loose tolerance I guess.🤷‍♂️ t.co

1555622076270219265.a: One strand of filament drooped because the support structure missed it. You can use auto supports for this but on really large things I like to build in the supports. You can also include break-away hooks or posts for painting. after painting break it off and touch up the spot.🎨 t.co

1555634056867549184.a: No more tripping over the power cord or moving the fan around the room while I am trying to use this space. Not sure this is the final location so I clamped it. I left 5mm gap on either side for HD foam to help keep from vibrating the plywood and making noise. t.co
